selector.omitted_behavior: existing duration-based wait when watch_id is also omitted

completion_requires: required exact original reserve endpoint observed true
progression: shared ordinary foreground owner; other retained plans continue during the same world time
publication: persist each complete slice before further effects; failed publication stops advancement
reserve_semantics: clip at immutable original absolute tick; later stock cannot repair missing or failed endpoint evidence; sealed action deadlines unchanged
reserve_evidence_retention: exact owned observation and bounded snapshot across calls; process-local, non-durable, cleared on restore
output_semantics: retain selected_plan_wait and elapsed-work counters together in every fitting output tier
replay: record optional selected original digest and reproduce the observed early frontier
